initial_query: Find an existing school building to create a spring section (sezione primavera) for 14 children, integrated into an existing kindergarten in Turin with at least 180 sqm of gross floor area in energy class C or better near public transport.
submitted_query: Find an existing school building to create a spring section (sezione primavera) for 14 children, integrated into an existing kindergarten in Turin with at least 180 sqm of gross floor area in energy class C or better near public transport.
final_sql:
SELECT
  *
FROM ESTATES
WHERE
  property_type = 'Attività scolastiche'
  AND surface_area >= 180
  AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C')
  AND mobility >= 51
  AND HAVERSINE_KM(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0
ORDER BY
  HAVERSINE_KM(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC

clarifications.I: I am looking for an existing school building.
clarifications.D: I intend to create a spring section (sezione primavera), integrated into an existing kindergarten.

clarifications.Ce: I have no requirement on the energy class.
clarifications.Cp: I prefer properties near public transport.

requirements.description: Energy class C or better (A1 through C). Energy score class cannot isolate C from D/E, so the energy_class column is used. The other requests (14 children, 180 sqm gross floor area, Turin location, proximity to public transport) are not energy efficiency requirements and were not translated into filters.

The user explicitly requires at least 180 sqm of gross floor area. The 14-children capacity is not converted into an area filter. Energy class and public transport proximity are not reference columns and are handled elsewhere. The Turin location is not mapped to comune_code because it was not supplied as a cadastral code.

The building must be near public transport (metro, bus, stations). The user asked for proximity to public transport, so the value is set at the 75th percentile of the mobility distribution (70.93, rounded to 71).

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Attività scolastiche' AND surface_area >= 180 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C') AND mobility >= 71 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Selects school-type buildings (Attività scolastiche) with surface_area of at least 180 sqm, energy class A1–A4, B or C, and mobility score of at least 71. Restricts to within 3.0 km of the supplied coordinates (45.0677551, 7.6824892) and orders by haversine distance ascending. Predicates are ordered from strictest to softest. No comune_code predicate is applied, since the place name is not a cadastral identifier.
